title: Spent my GameJam creativity on re-creating "The Movies" - a game I miss deeply - by making a game about re-making fictional spoof movies.  It's Showtime!
author: loulibra
selftext:
Would love some opinions or anyone to try it out,  and note: YES the menus are very broken when you've finished a level, if you manage to pass a premiere, it should save - and you can Quit + Restart to continue - you may get teleported out the main doors and locked out :) bugs be damned it's a fun little machinima toy, with more time It may have some real legs.

Good luck to all who gamejammed, first time for me, and more of an ai social experiment to see how far I could push with all the fun goodies we were given.  I learned a shit ton and will be using 5.9 going forward.

Day 1 devlog is up on the page too, and I'll share the other days soon!  Cheers.

comments.author: -CaptainFormula-
comments.body:
